module: nShield F2 4000 [1], nShield F2 2000 [2] and nShield F2 500 [3]
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and initialized to Overall Level 2 per Security Policy
description: The nShield modules: nShield F2 4000, nShield F2 2000, and nShield F2 500 family of secure e-commerce HSMs are multi-tasking hardware modules that are optimized for performing modular arithmetic on very large integers. The nShield modules are FIPS 140-2 level 2 embedded devices. The units are identical in operation and only vary in the processing speed.
hardware_versions: nC3023P-4K0 [1], nC3023P-2K0 [2] and nC3023P-500 [3], Build Standard N
